def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # Width-1 raster tie-break: use the shorter output dimension as the fast raster side.
    if p.M > p.N:
        d = f.dram_w1_hz_ratio
        sgn = 1.0
    else:
        d = f.dram_w1_id_ratio
        sgn = -1.0

    # Common compute/L2 roof and the explicit split-K and family corrections retained from the parent.
    sm = np.maximum(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(d))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + w[0] * f.tm_regstaged + w[1] * f.tm_cta_warps
    s = s + w[2] * f.splitk_roofline_log_time
    s = s + 0.001 * sgn * f.tm_log_inst

    # tm_regstaged=1 identifies the register-staged two-stage family; its complement
    # identifies multistage kernels.  Resource costs are fitted separately for the
    # two families because the same allocation has a different latency-hiding trade.
    two_stage = f.tm_regstaged
    multistage = 1.0 - f.tm_regstaged
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        # Memory-bound kernels additionally pay for the latency-critical SM path.
        s = s + w[3] * two_stage * f.register_file_pressure
        s = s + w[4] * two_stage * f.shared_memory_pressure
        s = s + w[5] * two_stage * f.resident_block_scarcity
        s = s + w[6] * multistage * f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction
        s = s + w[7] * multistage * f.register_file_pressure
        s = s + w[8] * multistage * f.shared_memory_pressure
        s = s + w[9] * multistage * f.resident_block_scarcity
        s = s + w[10] * f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log
    else:
        # Compute-bound kernels expose stage prologue/epilogue and occupancy/resource
        # costs, but do not use the memory-only latency-round correction.
        s = s + w[11] * two_stage * f.register_file_pressure
        s = s + w[12] * two_stage * f.shared_memory_pressure
        s = s + w[13] * two_stage * f.resident_block_scarcity
        s = s + w[14] * multistage * f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction
        s = s + w[15] * multistage * f.register_file_pressure
        s = s + w[16] * multistage * f.shared_memory_pressure
        s = s + w[17] * multistage * f.resident_block_scarcity
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # Width-1 raster the tie-break below realises (current contract cannot see swizzle): along the shorter grid side.
    # M<=N: identity (M-fastest), A panels are the fast-dim panels; M>N: horizontal (N-fastest), B panels are.
    if p.M > p.N:
        d = f.dram_w1_hz_ratio
        sgn = 1.0
    else:
        d = f.dram_w1_id_ratio
        sgn = -1.0
    # DRAM leg: ONE consistent byte count for that raster (pool feature dram_w1_*): panels fetched once per one-CTA-per-SM
    # K-lockstep window (whole grid if co-resident in one round), re-fetched across windows unless the reuse distance fits L2,
    # plus C write, split-K partials, spills; DRAM time / ideal compute time. Replaces J1e's tm_dram_ratio + ref/rbs double count.
    # SM roof as in J1e: the L2->SM feed (priced at DRAM bandwidth, kappa at its physical bound 1) overlaps the math of the
    # same SM, so the SM runs at the slower of the two; DRAM keeps the imperfect-overlap p=2 combination.
    sm = np.maximum(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(d))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    # Efficiency the norm cannot see: register-staged 2-stage mainloop, CTA-wide barrier over more warps.
    s = s + w[0] * f.tm_regstaged + w[1] * f.tm_cta_warps
    # Split-K time model with an interior optimum, in log2 time.
    s = s + w[2] * f.splitk_roofline_log_time
    # Pure tie-break among raster variants that differ only in inst_total: sign fixed by physics (shorter-side raster),
    # scale fixed at P1's prior 1e-3 per log2(inst) (<< one score unit = 0.1 log2 time), so it is not a fitted feature.
    s = s + 0.001 * sgn * f.tm_log_inst
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # Width-1 raster the tie-break below realises (current contract cannot see swizzle): along the shorter grid side.
    # M<=N: identity (M-fastest), A panels are the fast-dim panels; M>N: horizontal (N-fastest), B panels are.
    if p.M > p.N:
        d = f.dram_w1_hz_ratio
        sgn = 1.0
    else:
        d = f.dram_w1_id_ratio
        sgn = -1.0
    # DRAM leg: one consistent byte count for the selected raster.
    sm = np.maximum(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(d))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    # Existing efficiency corrections.
    s = s + w[0] * f.tm_regstaged + w[1] * f.tm_cta_warps
    # When output work per SM is scarce, split-K can repair a deficient dispatch wave.
    # Once there is ample output work, use the tile-relative excess and charge the
    # reduction/refetch costs instead of applying one global split-K direction.
    if p.output_work_per_sm < 4096:
        s = s + w[2] * f.splitk_roofline_log_time
        s = s + w[3] * f.splitk_excess_log
        s = s + w[4] * f.wave_count_deficit
    else:
        s = s + w[5] * f.splitk_excess_log
        s = s + w[6] * f.serial_reduction_dependency
        s = s + w[7] * f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio
    # Memory-sensitive shapes must trade pipeline fill/drain against latency hiding,
    # residency resources, and the useful work assigned to each thread.
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        s = s + w[8] * f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction
        s = s + w[9] * f.register_file_pressure
        s = s + w[10] * f.shared_memory_pressure
        s = s + w[11] * f.occupancy_deficit
        s = s + w[12] * f.resident_block_scarcity
        s = s + w[13] * f.thread_work_granularity_deficit
        s = s + w[14] * f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log
    else:
        # In the compute roof, retain a direct cost for deeper pipelines rather than
        # rewarding multistaging through the latency-bound model.
        s = s + w[15] * f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction
    # Pure tie-break among raster variants; the sign follows the shorter-side raster.
    s = s + 0.001 * sgn * f.tm_log_inst
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    if p.M > p.N:
        d = f.dram_w1_hz_ratio
        sgn = 1.0
    else:
        d = f.dram_w1_id_ratio
        sgn = -1.0
    sm = np.maximum(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(d))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + w[0] * f.tm_cta_warps
    s = s + w[1] * f.splitk_roofline_log_time
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        s = s + w[2] * f.tm_regstaged
        s = s + w[3] * f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction
        s = s + w[4] * f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log
        s = s + w[5] * f.resident_block_scarcity
        if p.output_work_per_sm < 4096:
            s = s + w[19] * f.splitk_excess_log
            s = s + w[20] * f.wave_count_deficit
    else:
        s = s + w[6] * f.tm_regstaged
        s = s + w[7] * f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction
        s = s + w[8] * f.register_file_pressure
        s = s + w[9] * f.shared_memory_pressure
        s = s + w[10] * f.resident_block_scarcity
        if p.output_work_per_sm < 4096:
            s = s + w[21] * f.splitk_excess_log
            s = s + w[22] * f.wave_count_deficit
        else:
            s = s + w[23] * f.splitk_excess_log
            s = s + w[24] * f.serial_reduction_dependency
            s = s + w[25] * np.log2(1.0 + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio)
    if p.output_aspect_imbalance > 0.5:
        if p.output_work_per_sm < 4096:
            s = s + w[11] * np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste)
            s = s + w[12] * np.log2(1.0 + f.tail_waste / np.maximum(1e-6, 1.0 - f.tail_waste))
            s = s + w[13] * f.thread_work_granularity_deficit
            s = s + w[14] * np.log2(1.0 + f.tile_aspect_mismatch)
            s = s + w[15] * np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio)
            s = s + w[16] * (f.shared_memory_pressure + f.resident_block_scarcity + f.register_file_pressure) * (1.0 + f.thread_work_granularity_deficit + np.log2(1.0 + f.tile_aspect_mismatch))
    if p.output_work_per_sm >= 4096:
        s = s + w[17] * np.log2(1.0 + d) * (1.0 + f.resident_block_scarcity)
        s = s + w[18] * np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * (1.0 + f.resident_block_scarcity)
        if p.l2_working_set_pressure > 0.5:
            if p.M > p.N:
                s = s + w[26] * np.log2(1.0 + f.b_refetch_bw_demand)
            else:
                s = s + w[27] * np.log2(1.0 + f.a_refetch_bw_demand)
    s = s + 0.001 * sgn * f.tm_log_inst
    return s
